name: trend check v0.3, pre-registered
note: Fixed before any count of the new controls or of start years other than 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020 and 2025 was made. Do not edit; additions go in a new file and are labelled exploratory.
primary: H1: in no-phase trials the three families' 2025/2008 share ratios rank above the controls' (exact one-sided rank-sum test, alpha 0.05). Replicates the exploratory 0.2.0 result with 12 controls it never saw.
H2: in other (phased) trials the same test gives p >= 0.05 (no disability-specific rise).
secondary: For every phrase and stratum: the share in each start year 2008-2025 and the least-squares slope of log(share) on year; the families' slopes ranked among the controls' slopes with the same exact test.
VA-led trials against the registry (sponsor_check.py) within no-phase trials, with all 23 controls, the same test.
rules: A control with fewer than min_first_year_matches matches in 2008 in a stratum is left out of that stratum's tests and listed as left out.
Every result is reported, whichever way it goes, next to the 0.2.0 numbers and never in place of them.
Counts are the registry's own search (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, interventional studies, by start date), fetched in one run.
